sql_templates.name: latest_stage_2_sectors
sql_templates.sql:
WITH latest_stage AS (
    SELECT sector, MAX(snapshot_date) AS latest_date
    FROM scores.stage_snapshots
    WHERE stage = 'STAGE_2'
    GROUP BY sector
), 
ranked_sectors AS (
    SELECT b.sector, b.pct_above_50dma, m.stage2_pct
    FROM breadth.sector_daily b
    JOIN breadth.ma_pct_above m 
    ON b.snapshot_date = m.snapshot_date
    JOIN latest_stage l
    ON b.sector = l.sector
    WHERE b.snapshot_date = l.latest_date
    ORDER BY m.stage2_pct DESC
    LIMIT 10
)
SELECT * FROM ranked_sectors;
